questions.question_text: What is a key way to respect intellectual property and copyright laws when using someone else’s work in your project, as discussed in the chapter?

options.text: Using the content without giving any credit to the creator
Copying large sections of text or media and claiming it as your own
Citing the source or asking for permission before using the material
Ignoring copyright rules since it’s just for a school project

correct_answer.text: Citing the source or asking for permission before using the material

questions.question_text: What is an important ethical consideration when conducting surveys or collecting data for a school project, according to the chapter?

options.text: Collecting data without telling participants the purpose of your research
Sharing participants’ personal information publicly to make your report detailed
Getting informed consent and protecting participants’ privacy
Asking only personal and uncomfortable questions to get dramatic results

correct_answer.text: Getting informed consent and protecting participants’ privacy

questions.question_text: How can you avoid fabrication and falsification of data in your research, based on the chapter’s guidance?

options.text: Making up results to make your project look more impressive
Changing data to match what you hoped to find
Reporting only the actual data you collected, even if it’s not perfect
Ignoring data that doesn’t support your hypothesis

correct_answer.text: Reporting only the actual data you collected, even if it’s not perfect

questions.question_text: Why is cultural sensitivity important in research, as explained in the chapter?

options.text: It allows you to make assumptions and stereotypes about different groups
It helps you respect diverse backgrounds and avoid offending others in your work
It encourages you to ignore cultural differences for simplicity
It is only necessary when researching your own culture

correct_answer.text: It helps you respect diverse backgrounds and avoid offending others in your work
